svg.title: Changelog: shipping Sift, curating data with Winnow, reading with Gloss

g.text: A team of AI analysts your company can talk to. Multi-agent planning, SQL and charts.
Multimodal video + audio curation: raw media to enriched, de-duplicated, balanced training data.
A research reader with margin highlights, notes, AI section summaries and a citation graph.
